sents.t: Thanksgiving is on the fourth Thursday in November.
It is a very important holiday in America.
Families say thank you for the good things in their lives.
This year, Rosa invited me to her family’s Thanksgiving dinner.
Danny, his wife, and their two kids came.
I helped in the kitchen all morning.
Rosa cooked a big turkey in the oven for five hours.
At four o’clock, we all sat at the long table.
Rosa said, “Let’s say what we are thankful for.”
Danny’s daughter said, “I’m thankful for my puppy.” Carlos said, “I’m thankful for my students.” Then it was my turn.
“Five months ago, I didn’t know anyone here,” I said.
“Now I have a home, a job, and wonderful friends. I’m thankful for all of you.”
After dinner, we watched football on TV.
I ate too much, and I was very, very happy.
